selection: Earliest hand-detected ambiguous approach and latest hand-detected ambiguous withdrawal per take; same rule as VIDEO03, no score-driven selection; paired views and ±0.3s offline annotation context.
annotation: Only clearly not-held central event times are negative. Possible contact remains unknown. Per-view timing mismatches remain unknown. No positive labels added; old eroded labels retained.
weights: Original VIDEO03 equal take/class/view weights versus splitting each negative take/class/view weight equally between old interiors and new hard negatives when both available.
evaluation: Report old P_validation interiors, old post-hoc challenge, extra-take interiors and new extra-take events separately; whole takes excluded from training. Extra takes share known sessions and were automatically scored earlier; not new independent holdout.
qualification: Must reduce false-held transition errors without erasing labelled held recall. Results are observation diagnostics only. Never confer motor control authority.
